prs.head: codex/issue22-independent-launch-20261021
prs.body:
## 独立起動の検証結果
既存予約を正規APIで再有効化：成功。ただしnext_run_time=null/履歴なし。再有効化後のrun_now1回はHTTP404 Action not found（実行前）で失敗し、反復していません。

別の単発probe1回を登録し、その保存済み指示がユーザーの追加手動指示なしに既存のアクティブ会話へ到着しました。provider last_run_timeは2026-10-21T10:12:35.957224UTCへ更新、one-off is_enabled=false。**next_run_time=nullでも今回の指示到着は観測できたため、nullを無効の証拠にはできません。** nullの原因コード・provider runID/run_detailsは未取得です。

これはアクティブな同じhostでの予定指示到着であり、独立cold-startのshell/model/state取得や自動コード実装成功の証拠ではありません。通常予約の日時/回数は変更・延長せず、probeは再登録していません。

## 固定次タスク入力を保存
B検索race input2de6670bac8afc0ce778b844a988366fca9bca8e：保護browser5FAIL。
C checkpoint budget input279d28e0859f7778491c8573bdd8f9015d1bb179：Python11tests/15subcaseFAIL。
D error redaction inpute4c0578dda6e4fa3833cd813b29ed78dc454c7ca：browser2PASS/2FAIL。
元source未変更。厳密manifest/baseSHA/protectedhash/条件/risk/依存をdocs/workers/ready-inputs/へ保存。

## 実callback内の安全停止
GitHubのPR34/本PRの固定docs読取り、元4taskの実spec_hash/status一致、共有state継続、activelease0、fresh complete29PR snapshot、3候補のGitobject/protectedSHA256を確認。PR34planは全3候補をoverlapping_open_prでBLOCKEDとし、source worker/lease/実装commit/実装PRなし。ゲートを緩めず停止しました。

実際の公開証拠：docs/qa/independent-launch-20261021/scheduled-callback-observation.json、actual-input-readiness.json、overlap-review-required.json。報告保存コミットはソース実装完了ではありません。

## 残る条件
legacyPRの継承/重複整理、次回の独立hostで正式collaboration/shell/同じ永続state/既存GitHub権限が使えることの実証。GitHubActionsは既存CIとして利用できても未接続modelworkerは動かせず、featurebranch scheduleも自動起動しません。crontabなし/user systemd offline/CLI EROFS既知。新規secret/API課金やauthcopy/bypassなし。

無人開発全体：BLOCKED。scheduled prompt deliveryのみ観測PASS。main/productionDB/SQL/deploy/課金なし。

+# Independent launch verification — 2026-10-21
+
+Status BLOCKED: no independent scheduler-to-code completion observed.
+Base PR34 at0a24e1935cb18efcc36ee75666de5b282e8ed3f4. This branch preserves all earlier sources.
+
+## Executed scheduler operations
+Existing recurring reservation is enabled, next_run_time null, last_run_time2026-10-21T04:53:25Z, no recorded last_run/latest_result. Re-enabling through supported update succeeded at10:05UTC but an independent peek still returns null. Supported immediate run requested ONCE after re-enable: HTTP404 Action not found BEFORE action invocation; this is not an accepted launch, model run or authentication recovery. No repeating that action.
+Valid finite iCal rule still has future mathematical occurrences (next10:55:17UTC at observation10:06:48UTC). A locally calculated occurrence is NOT provider confirmation. Null next_run_time alone does not prove disabled/exhausted; provider gives no null-reason or scheduling diagnostic endpoint. Exact cause UNKNOWN.
+
+A separate single-use independent verification probe was created successfully with relative five-minute exact schedule (DTSTART20261021T101325Z). It is not a recurring replacement or extension of the original28-occurrence reservation. It shares the same durable lease checks; runs at most1 ready task and cannot recreate itself. It too reports next_run_time null at creation. Registration is not execution evidence. Root must inspect callback/provider run history after the due time. Do not rerun completed tasks, reset original finite count or invent a provider run ID.
+
+## Ready fixed inputs (implementation not started)
+B: codex/issue22-b-search-input-20261021 @2de6670bac8afc0ce778b844a988366fca9bca8e. Protected mobile browser5/5 baselineFAIL: late result overwrite, input debounce race, clear resurrection, thrown spinner, stale failure.
+C: codex/c-checkpoint-budget-input-20261021 @279d28e0859f7778491c8573bdd8f9015d1bb179. Protected Python11 tests,15 subcases baselineFAIL for invalid max_bytes; own synthetic checkpoint only.
+D: codex/issue22-d-redaction-input-20261021 @e4c0578dda6e4fa3833cd813b29ed78dc454c7ca. Protected mobile browser4 tests,2PASS/2FAIL; save/share synthetic error marker leaks. Existing gesture/stale cases remainPASS.
+Exact manifests and coordinator-reviewed metadata in ready-inputs/. These are fixed-test input commits, NOT implementation outputs. Source unchanged. Keep dependencies in trusted parent outside prepared worktrees and cache in owned temporary directories.
+A poll: no owner-approved production catalog/GoTrue environment, so release integration remainsBLOCKED; do not fabricate a new A task or connect production.
+
+All candidates STILL require fresh complete PR file/head snapshots and PR34 plan. Inherited ancestors may be explicitly pinned; divergent overlaps (notably C/PR21) remainBLOCKED until independently reconciled. A descriptor with baseline evidence is not global authorization to bypass overlap gates. Shared original4-task state continuity must be checked; missing state→read-only, never create replacement SQLite.
+
+## Alternative execution backends checked
+GitHub Actions can independently execute CI (existing witnessed runs), but feature-branch schedules do not activate; default-branch schedule is validation-only and gated byPOKERID_VALIDATION_SCHEDULE_ENABLED. No standalone model authentication/publisher is configured there, and host collaboration tools cannot be invoked by shell. Installing a timer alone would not create AI workers. No main merge or secret registration performed.
+Local crontab unavailable. systemctl binary presence is not evidence of persistent service ownership or cross-session availability. Existing nested Codex CLI has known managed EROFS before model startup; do not move CODEX_HOME/copy credentials/bypass sandbox or repeat probe. Current cloud environment running/connected does not prove scheduler callbacks attach to it. No configured external runner/service credential bindings are exposed by environment_status.
+
+## Required external conditions if probe cannot run
+1. Scheduler owner/provider must expose a real next invocation and run/result history (task UI/service-side repair); API returned null/no cause and run_now404. This is not fixed by granting productionDB permission.
+2. That scheduled host must expose formal collaboration+shell+existing GitHub branch/PR access under approved subscription, or an independently approved no-new-cost runner with legitimate model auth. Current tools cannot provision that missing service.
+3. Same durable shared state must survive the independent invocation; otherwise reconcile stopped workers/PRs before any new lease. Public GitHub checkpoint is not private-state recovery.
+4. Complete fresh PR overlap review before dispatch. No safety gate may be weakened to make a probe green.
+No new paid API/service, production DB/SQL/deploy, main merge or original checkpoint changes.
+
+## Actual readiness gate result
+The root verified all3 exact input Gitobjects and every protected-file SHA256, then invoked PR34 Continuation.plan against a fresh complete29-open-PR file/head snapshot and the actual existing sharedstate. All3 were BLOCKED withoverlapping_open_pr; none was leased or dispatched. See docs/qa/independent-launch-20261021/actual-input-readiness.json and overlap-review-required.json. Some ancestor pins can be completed by coordinator review; divergent legacy PRs must be reconciled without changing immutable candidate IDs in-place. These are execution-input-complete, NOT globally ready tasks.
+`systemctl --user is-system-running` returned offline; no user service was installed. crontab absent. Service binary presence is not a usable autonomous model host.
+
+## Scheduled prompt actually arrived
+At about10:12:36UTC the single-use saved probe prompt arrived in the already-active root conversation without another manual request. Subsequent provider peek shows last_run_time10:12:35.957224UTC and is_enabled=false (one-off consumed), while next_run_time remainsnull and run_details.last_run/latest_result remainnull. Thus null next_run_time did NOT prevent this observed prompt delivery. Root did not issue a second run_now or recreate the probe. The exact null-field cause remainsUNKNOWN.
+This is scheduled prompt arrival during an active host session, NOT evidence of a separate cold-start host, a provider runID, or scheduler-to-source completion. Root read both pinned GitHub docs, verified original4 immutable spec hashes/statuses against the retainedstate and checked fresh29PR snapshots. All3 candidate plans wereBLOCKED by openPR path overlap, so no source worker/lease/implementation commit/implementation PR was created in the probe. Full public evidence: scheduled-callback-observation.json. A report-only commit is not model development completion.
+No user action is needed to re-create this already-consumed probe. Remaining integration work is legacyPR overlap reconciliation and independently witnessed scheduled host capability/state continuity after this chat is inactive. A scheduler provider run record is still unavailable; do not invent an ID or claim daemon startup.

PR26に既存stateのcontinuity anchor、レビュー済み候補の固定SHA/保護テストhash/失敗baseline/依存/新鮮なPR差分ゲート、永続run IDと縮小のみ可能な有限budgetを追加。Markdownの未完了checkboxからreview_required候補を抽出します。新仕様を自動承認する機能ではありません。

停止確認済みquota/transientのみ一度延期し、元worktree/HEAD/source/protected hashを再検証してresume。認証/権限/生存不明・期限切れleaseは奪取しません。token/SQLite/private receiptは公開しません。

## 実際の起動・復旧証拠
A基盤、B回答採点、C rank7、D doubleclickを正式hostで実装し、controllerが独立テスト/hash/commitを検証。新Draft PR32/33/35と本PRのCIが成功。4完了taskの再claimは0/4。

最新CI全工程SUCCESS（固定13＋既存worker22＋queue15）：https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39573451705
証拠 docs/qa/issue22-recovery-20261021/、再開契約 docs/workers/ISSUE22_RESTART_STATE_20261021.md、MASTER更新。四系列の次の具体的候補も保存済み（未実装、固定失敗baseline準備前）。

## 未完成の境界
既存有限予約のpromptは候補準備/host lifecycle/延期復旧に接続し、日時・回数を変更していません。しかしnext_run_timeはnull、run_detailsなしで次回scheduled cold-start実装完了は未確認。常駐daemonはなく、CLI EROFSも未解消。外部から利用上限を解除できません。既存予約残回数を確認できないため追加local reserve_run予算を本番有効化していません。共有state消失時は公開checkpointからprivate leaseを再生成せずread-only。

+# Reviewed continuation and host recovery
+
+Implemented component: `scripts/continuation_recovery.py`. This extends PR26; it
+is not a daemon, a new scheduler, an external quota detector, or proof of a later
+unattended implementation. It performs no network, production DB, credential,
+billing or deployment operations. Formal host collaboration remains necessary.
+
+## Replenishment contract
+
+`extract_candidates` turns unchecked Markdown checkboxes from bounded
+host-provided MASTER/Issue/QA snapshots into **review_required suggestions only**.
+Untrusted text never supplies executable commands or becomes a ready task.
+A trusted host must review a precise task descriptor, record its purpose,
+execution/completion conditions, dependencies, references and low/medium risk,
+pin its full baseSHA, exact writable paths and protected tests, and independently
+witness a failing fixed baseline. The baseline includes test count, profile,
+baseSHA and exact protected-file SHA256s; this is a coordinator attestation,
+not cryptographic evidence of review or model identity.
+
+`Continuation.plan(candidates, observations, repository)` verifies Git object
+existence/protected hashes, fixed allowlisted profiles and immutable IDs. It
+requires a complete PR head/file snapshot at most120s old. Existing tasks,
+active lane leases, unmet dependencies, duplicate branches and overlapping
+open PR paths block dispatch. Reviewed `inherited_prs` may explicitly permit a
+known PR's paths only if the exact observed headSHA is pinned and Git ancestry
+proves that head is contained in the candidate base. This is not permission to
+merge both PRs blindly. One candidate per lane, at most four per plan. A plan is
+not a lease or an implementation; use PR26 prepare → formal dispatch → finish.
+
+No real candidate catalog is silently synthesized or activated by this module.
+The host must supply fresh GitHub observations and reviewed immutable descriptors.
+When only suggestions exist, save them and stop that lane rather than weakening
+acceptance or inventing a product specification.
+
+## Durable state and finite invocation bounds
+
+Open `Continuation(state, anchor)` only against the **existing** shared lease DB.
+The nonempty coordinator-owned anchor maps previously known immutable job IDs to
+their spec_hash. Missing/symlinked state, missing schema or mismatched anchors fail
+closed. Do not replace lost state with an empty database. Public checkpoints can
+help reconcile GitHub PRs but cannot reconstruct private leases or prove no
+worker is still active. Instance replacement still requires a genuinely durable
+state store; publishing SQLite or private receipts is prohibited.
+
+`reserve_run(id)` atomically records distinct invocations with a local upper cap
+of28. Duplicate invocation IDs are rejected across process restarts. This local
+counter **does not preserve or restart the existing finite reservation by itself**.
+Before an actual scheduled launcher uses it, import the verified remaining count
+of the original reservation with `restrict_remaining_runs(remaining)`. This can
+only shrink the persisted local limit, never extend/reset it. If the scheduler's
+remaining context is unknown, do not launch. No reservation was changed here.
+The host must still impose its30min batch and180s worker limit; this planning
+library is not a replacement for the scheduler/host timeout boundary.
+
+## Safe stop and one delayed retry
+
+The trusted coordinator must stop the real formal agent first and call
+`defer_host(id, PRIVATE_token, kind, agent_stopped=True, ...)`. Only coordinator
+failure classes are accepted, never raw exceptions: quota/transient may receive
+one delayed retry; authentication/permission/runtime/unknown become BLOCKED.
+The component cannot directly inspect or clear a ChatGPT/Codex account quota.
+It can consume a witnessed host error and a bounded retry timestamp (1s..24h).
+A retry is an attempt when permitted, not proof quota has recovered; another
+failure exhausts the task's two-attempt cap. No CLI EROFS probes, HOME/CODEX_HOME
+moves, credential copying or sandbox bypass are introduced.
+
+Before deferring, the checkpoint verifies unchanged HEAD, unchanged protected
+acceptance, strict allowed paths, no symlink/deletion/escape and SHA256 of all
+retained sources. Context and checkpoint stay private in the same SQLite DB.
+`resume_host` reopens that state, waits until retry time, rechecks the checkpoint,
+uses the existing lease transaction for lane exclusion and renews the same task
+with a new token while preserving its worktree. The returned receipt is PRIVATE:
+never give it to the model or GitHub. A successful resume is only **prepared**;
+the host must dispatch its actual formal collaboration agent and later invoke
+`finish_host_session` with an independently witnessed trusted receipt.
+
+Expired/crashed leases are not stolen or automatically recovered. Unknown agent
+liveness, changed retained source/protected tests or missing state requires safe
+stop and coordinator review. Keeping a worktree is not a claim that arbitrary
+in-flight execution can resume safely after a crash.
+
+## Verification and limits
+
+Protected acceptance under `tests/worker_acceptance/test_continuation_recovery.py`
+uses isolated Git repositories/SQLite and verifies candidate gates, continuity,
+finite-run/replay exclusion, next-task selection, deferred quota-equivalent
+stop/reopen/resume, retained source, actual fixed tests and a controller commit,
+one retry only, permission failure stopping, checkpoint tamper rejection and
+safe public export. Fixtures explicitly set `test_fixture=true`; they are not
+proof that a new unattended AI or later schedule invocation ran.
+
+The read-only GitHub workflow also executes the existing22worker and15queue
+regressions. Root should record the published commit/actual CI result separately.
+No production release, GoTrue verification, account-quota recovery, persistent
+scheduler installation or future cold-start-to-code completion is implied.
+
+## Dependency provisioning remains a separate gate
+
+Do not run `npm ci` or create ignored dependency files after the host has captured
+its protected preparation snapshot and treat those deltas as model source.
+Provision verified pinned dependencies before source dispatch using a separately
+reviewed setup lifecycle. No ignored-file/path guard was weakened by this
+component, and no API to bless arbitrary dependency deltas is provided. If a
+prepared worktree acquires unexpected node_modules/ignored deltas, preserve it
+and BLOCK rather than manually replacing the snapshot to obtain PASS.

+"""Reviewed continuation planning and bounded host-session recovery.
+
+A host adapter, not a daemon, quota detector or authentication provider. Only the
+trusted coordinator may attest review, baseline results and stopped agents.
+"""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sqlite3
+import time
+
+from code_worker import Leases, command, protected_hashes, validate_spec
+
+
+def digest(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def extract_candidates(sources):
+    """Extract suggestions only. Untrusted issue/document text never becomes code."""
+    suggestions = []
+    for source in sources[:100]:
+        if source.get('lane') not in ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D'):
+            continue
+        for line in str(source.get('text', '')).splitlines()[:1000]:
+            match = re.match(r'^\s*[-*]\s+\[ \]\s+(.+)$', line)
+            if match:
+                suggestions.append({'lane': source['lane'], 'reference': str(source.get('reference', ''))[:300],
+                                    'title': match[1][:200], 'status': 'review_required'})
+                if len(suggestions) >= 100:
+                    return suggestions
+    return suggestions
+
+
+class Continuation:
+    def __init__(self, state, anchor):
+        """Never create a replacement for missing durable development state.
+
+        Anchor is a coordinator-retained map of existing immutable job IDs to
+        spec_hash. It is not a GitHub-exported database or a secret token.
+        """
+        self.path = Path(state)
+        if not self.path.is_file() or self.path.is_symlink() or not anchor:
+            raise ValueError('existing durable state and nonempty continuity anchor required')
+        probe = sqlite3.connect('file:' + str(self.path.resolve()) + '?mode=ro', uri=True)
+        try:
+            for ident, expected in anchor.items():
+                row = probe.execute('SELECT spec_hash FROM development_jobs WHERE id=?', (ident,)).fetchone()
+                if row is None or row[0] != expected:
+                    raise ValueError('durable state continuity anchor mismatch')
+        except sqlite3.Error:
+            raise ValueError('durable lease schema unavailable') from None
+        finally:
+            probe.close()
+        self.leases = Leases(self.path)
+        self.db = self.leases.db
+        self.db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS continuation_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, started REAL NOT NULL)')
+        self.db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS continuation_limits (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), run_limit INTEGER NOT NULL)')
+        self.db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO continuation_limits VALUES(1,28)')
+        self.db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS continuation_candidates (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL)')
+        self.db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS continuation_failures (
+            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, not_before REAL NOT NULL,
+            context TEXT NOT NULL, checkpoint TEXT NOT NULL)''')
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.leases.close()
+
+    def restrict_remaining_runs(self, remaining):
+        """Import existing scheduler remainder. Never extend/reset its finite cap."""
+        if type(remaining) is not int or not 0 <= remaining <= 28:
+            raise ValueError('remaining original schedule count must be in 0..28')
+        self.db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        try:
+            used = self.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM continuation_runs').fetchone()[0]
+            self.db.execute('UPDATE continuation_limits SET run_limit=MIN(run_limit,?) WHERE id=1', (used + remaining,))
+            self.db.execute('COMMIT')
+        except BaseException:
+            self.db.execute('ROLLBACK'); raise
+
+    def reserve_run(self, run_id, now=None):
+        """Book one finite host invocation. Does not invoke an AI/scheduler."""
+        if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}', run_id):
+            raise ValueError('bounded immutable invocation ID required')
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        self.db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        try:
+            used = self.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM continuation_runs').fetchone()[0]
+            limit = self.db.execute('SELECT run_limit FROM continuation_limits WHERE id=1').fetchone()[0]
+            existing = self.db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM continuation_runs WHERE id=?', (run_id,)).fetchone()
+            if existing or used >= min(28, limit):
+                self.db.execute('COMMIT'); return False
+            self.db.execute('INSERT INTO continuation_runs VALUES(?,?)', (run_id, now))
+            self.db.execute('COMMIT'); return True
+        except BaseException:
+            self.db.execute('ROLLBACK'); raise
+
+    def _candidate(self, candidate, repository):
+        task = candidate['task']
+        validate_spec({'version': 1, 'repository': 'kyoma1015/poker-sns', 'tasks': [task]})
+        if candidate.get('reviewed') is not True or candidate.get('risk') not in ('low', 'medium'):
+            raise ValueError('review_and_risk_required')
+        for name in ('purpose', 'execution_conditions', 'completion_conditions', 'references'):
+            if not candidate.get(name):
+                raise ValueError('missing_review_metadata')
+        if any(any(char in path for char in '*?[]') for path in task['allowed_paths'] + task['protected_tests']):
+            raise ValueError('exact_paths_required')
+        if command(['git', 'rev-parse', task['base_sha'] + '^{commit}'], repository) != task['base_sha']:
+            raise ValueError('base_missing')
+        baseline = candidate.get('baseline', {})
+        if (baseline.get('source') != 'trusted_host_verified' or baseline.get('failed') is not True
+                or type(baseline.get('test_count')) is not int or baseline['test_count'] < 1
+                or baseline.get('base_sha') != task['base_sha'] or baseline.get('test_profile') != task['test_profile']):
+            raise ValueError('fixed_failed_baseline_required')
+        expected = baseline.get('protected_sha256', {})
+        if set(expected) != set(task['protected_tests']):
+            raise ValueError('fixed_acceptance_hashes_required')
+        for path, sha in expected.items():
+            # cat-file reads exact Git bytes rather than mutable working-tree files.
+            import subprocess
+            proc = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', 'cat-file', 'blob', task['base_sha'] + ':' + path],
+                                  cwd=repository, capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=False)
+            if proc.returncode or hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout).hexdigest() != sha:
+                raise ValueError('protected_acceptance_mismatch')
+        for dependency in candidate.get('dependencies', []):
+            row = self.db.execute('SELECT status FROM development_jobs WHERE id=?', (dependency,)).fetchone()
+            if row is None or row[0] != 'implemented':
+                raise ValueError('dependency_incomplete')
+        return task
+
+    def plan(self, candidates, observations, repository, now=None):
+        """Return <=4 reviewed descriptors. Still requires host prepare/dispatch/finish.
+
+        Fresh complete PR file/head observations come from the authorized host.
+        Reading only titles or CI does not constitute a complete overlap check.
+        """
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        result = {'manifest': {'version': 1, 'repository': 'kyoma1015/poker-sns', 'tasks': []},
+                  'blocked': [], 'daemon_running': False}
+        stamp = observations.get('checked_at')
+        if (observations.get('complete') is not True or not isinstance(stamp, (int, float))
+                or not -5 <= now - stamp <= 120 or not isinstance(observations.get('open_prs'), list)):
+            result['blocked'].append({'reason': 'fresh_complete_pr_snapshot_required'}); return result
+        if not isinstance(candidates, list) or len(candidates) > 100:
+            raise ValueError('bounded reviewed candidate catalog required')
+        selected = set()
+        for candidate in candidates:
+            ident = candidate.get('task', {}).get('id', 'unknown')
+            try:
+                task = self._candidate(candidate, repository)
+                hashed = digest(candidate)
+                old = self.db.execute('SELECT spec_hash FROM continuation_candidates WHERE id=?', (ident,)).fetchone()
+                if old and old[0] != hashed:
+                    raise ValueError('immutable_candidate_changed')
+                self.db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO continuation_candidates VALUES(?,?)', (ident, hashed))
+                persisted = self.db.execute('SELECT spec_hash FROM continuation_candidates WHERE id=?', (ident,)).fetchone()
+                if persisted is None or persisted[0] != hashed:
+                    raise ValueError('immutable_candidate_changed')
+                existing = self.db.execute('SELECT status FROM development_jobs WHERE id=?', (ident,)).fetchone()
+                if existing:
+                    raise ValueError('existing_task_requires_reconciliation')
+                if self.db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM development_jobs WHERE lane=? AND status='running'", (task['lane'],)).fetchone():
+                    raise ValueError('active_lane_lease')
+                if task['lane'] in selected:
+                    raise ValueError('lane_selected')
+                inherited = candidate.get('inherited_prs', {})
+                for pr in observations['open_prs']:
+                    if not isinstance(pr.get('changed_paths'), list) or not isinstance(pr.get('head'), str):
+                        raise ValueError('incomplete_pr_files')
+                    if pr['head'] == task['branch']:
+                        raise ValueError('existing_branch_pr')
+                    if set(pr['changed_paths']) & set(task['allowed_paths']):
+                        pin = inherited.get(str(pr['number']))
+                        if pin != pr.get('head_sha') or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', str(pin)):
+                            raise ValueError('overlapping_open_pr')
+                        command(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', pin, task['base_sha']], repository)
+                selected.add(task['lane']); result['manifest']['tasks'].append(task)
+            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, RuntimeError):
+                # Reason codes only; candidate instructions, shell output or auth never logged.
+                import sys
+                error = sys.exc_info()[1]
+                reason = str(error)
+                if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_]{1,80}', reason):
+                    reason = 'candidate_validation_failed'
+                result['blocked'].append({'id': ident, 'reason': reason})
+        return result
+
+    def _checkpoint(self, context):
+        task = context['task']; worktree = Path(context['worktree'])
+        if command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], worktree) != context['base_sha']:
+            raise ValueError('checkpoint HEAD changed')
+        if protected_hashes(worktree, task['protected_tests']) != context['before']:
+            raise ValueError('protected checkpoint acceptance changed')
+        changed = set(command(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'], worktree).splitlines())
+        changed.update(command(['git', 'ls-files', '--others'], worktree).splitlines())
+        changed.update(command(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], worktree).splitlines())
+        if not changed <= set(task['allowed_paths']):
+            raise ValueError('out-of-scope checkpoint changes')
+        hashes = {}
+        for relative in task['allowed_paths']:
+            path = worktree / relative
+            if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(worktree.resolve()):
+                raise ValueError('unsafe checkpoint source')
+            if not path.exists():
+                # Missing paths are allowed only when not deleting tracked source.
+                if relative in changed:
+                    raise ValueError('checkpoint source deletion')
+                hashes[relative] = None
+            elif not path.is_file():
+                raise ValueError('checkpoint source is not a file')
+            else:
+                hashes[relative] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        return digest({'head': context['base_sha'], 'protected': context['before'], 'sources': hashes})
+
+    def defer_host(self, task_id, token, kind, *, agent_stopped, now=None, retry_after=300):
+        """Coordinator reports witnessed failure AFTER stopping the real agent.
+
+        Never pass raw exception text. Quota/transient get at most one delayed
+        retry; auth/permission/runtime/unknown failures require human/runtime fix.
+        """
+        if agent_stopped is not True:
+            raise ValueError('coordinator must stop agent before checkpoint')
+        if kind not in ('quota', 'transient', 'authentication', 'permission', 'runtime', 'unknown'):
+            raise ValueError('classified failure required')
+        if type(retry_after) not in (int, float) or not 1 <= retry_after <= 86400:
+            raise ValueError('bounded retry delay required')
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        self.db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        try:
+            row = self.db.execute("SELECT evidence,attempts FROM development_jobs WHERE id=? AND token=? AND status='running' AND expires>?", (task_id, token, now)).fetchone()
+            if row is None:
+                raise ValueError('missing or expired lease; no automatic stealing')
+            context = json.loads(row[0])
+            if context.get('prepared_for') != 'host_session':
+                raise ValueError('host prepared context required')
+            checkpoint = self._checkpoint(context)
+            retry = kind in ('quota', 'transient') and row[1] < 2
+            self.db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO continuation_failures VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',
+                            (task_id, kind, now + retry_after, json.dumps(context), checkpoint))
+            self.leases.finish(task_id, token, 'retry_wait' if retry else 'blocked',
+                               {'failure_class': kind, 'checkpoint_preserved': True, 'retry_eligible': retry}, now=now)
+            self.db.execute('COMMIT')
+            return {'id': task_id, 'status': 'deferred' if retry else 'blocked', 'failure_class': kind,
+                    'retry_after': now + retry_after if retry else None}
+        except BaseException:
+            self.db.execute('ROLLBACK'); raise
+
+    def resume_host(self, task_id, now=None):
+        """Return PRIVATE prepared receipt for trusted host dispatch, never publish.
+
+        Existing context/worktree is retained and revalidated. Requires a new
+        formal host dispatch; a recovered lease is not real source execution.
+        """
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        row = self.db.execute('SELECT kind,not_before,context,checkpoint FROM continuation_failures WHERE id=?', (task_id,)).fetchone()
+        job = self.db.execute('SELECT status,attempts FROM development_jobs WHERE id=?', (task_id,)).fetchone()
+        if not row or not job or row[0] not in ('quota', 'transient') or row[1] > now or job[0] != 'retry_wait' or job[1] >= 2:
+            return None
+        context = json.loads(row[2])
+        if self._checkpoint(context) != row[3]:
+            raise ValueError('retained worktree changed after stop; review required')
+        token = self.leases.claim(context['task'], seconds=360, now=now)
+        if token is None:
+            return None
+        self.db.execute("UPDATE development_jobs SET evidence=? WHERE id=? AND token=? AND status='running'",
+                        (json.dumps(context), task_id, token))
+        return {'id': task_id, 'status': 'prepared', 'executor': 'host_session',
+                'worktree': context['worktree'], 'lease_token': token,
+                'real_ai_implementation': False, 'recovered_checkpoint': True}
+
+    def public_checkpoint(self):
+        """Token/context-free progress for GitHub. Cannot replace private state."""
+        return {'version': 1, 'daemon_running': False, 'run_count': self.db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM continuation_runs').fetchone()[0],
+                'run_limit': self.db.execute('SELECT run_limit FROM continuation_limits WHERE id=1').fetchone()[0],
+                'jobs': [dict(zip(('id','lane','status','attempts'), row)) for row in self.db.execute('SELECT id,lane,status,attempts FROM development_jobs ORDER BY id')],
+                'failures': [dict(zip(('id','failure_class','retry_at'), row)) for row in self.db.execute('SELECT id,kind,not_before FROM continuation_failures ORDER BY id')]}

+# Poker ID — Coding Agent Instructions
+
+This document configures code agents operating in this repository. Follow these rules before any task.
+
+## Objective
+Build and maintain Poker ID, a Japanese poker community and learning platform. Four development lines:
+- A: application audit, security, authorization and shared UI
+- B: TDA quiz and rule references
+- C: GTO solver and computational validation
+- D: 50-question player-type diagnosis and 36 animal classifications
+
+## Start of each task
+1. Read `docs/progress/MASTER.md`, `docs/progress/AGENT_OPERATING_RULES.md`, and the relevant line-specific progress file.
+2. Inspect the actual files, branch, recent commits, relevant tests and open PRs. Do not treat progress notes as proof of current runtime state.
+3. Record the test/acceptance criteria before changing code.
+4. Identify all shared files and other development lines affected.

+## Development workflow
+- Work only in a dedicated branch; never push directly to `main`.
+- Keep changes limited to the task. Do not erase other agents' or uncommitted changes.

+
+## Owner decision (2026-10-17; supersedes older poll/question-box plans)
+- **Ship polls (アンケート)**. Named/anonymous voting, 2–4 options, voter list as privacy permits, results, one owner notification at close.
+- **Do not ship question boxes (質問箱)**. Hide new-question creation UI and exclude question box from release. Preserve historical question data, existing internal code and DB; do not delete/migrate away historical rows.
+- Old PR #4 and new Draft PR #12 must be evaluated against this latest decision, not old descriptions.
+
+## Direct GitHub PR #12 patch inspection
+- `src/Timeline.tsx` has `(['poll'] as const)` for composer buttons, but still maintains `interactiveMode: 'normal'|'poll'|'question'` and a question composer path.
+- `src/TimelineInteractive.tsx` still has `QuestionThread` and renders it for `kind==='question'`. Internal historical support can remain, but exposure must be explicitly reviewed.
+- `sql/timeline_interactive_posts.sql` supports `kind='question'`; historical SQL is not to be re-applied or modified in production as part of this scope correction.
+- `tests/interactive-requests.test.mjs` tests poll voting and rejects question-kind via poll write contract; it does NOT prove question-box UI is hidden.
+
+## Mandatory acceptance tests before PR #12 release
+1. Home composer and bottom-nav post composer show exactly one interactive creation action: アンケート. No 質問箱 button or navigable new-question form.
+2. No UI path can submit `p_kind='question'` for a new post. Explicitly guard creation path against stale question mode, not only hide the button.
+3. Historical question data remains intact. Preserve internal code/DB; do not claim historical question UI visibility is approved without owner decision.
+4. Named polls show names/votes only under named mode; anonymous polls never expose voter identities, including RPC, RLS, notifications and history.
+5. Poll options 2–4, deadlines, results, voter list and exactly-once close notification tested against isolated DB and browser QA.
+6. Change docs/progress/SNS_INTERACTIVE.md and PR title/description to 'poll-only' scope. Mark question-box QA out of release scope. Avoid SQL execution.
+
+## Gate
+PR #12 is **NOT READY** for production integration until tests 1–2 and privacy validation pass. No main merge or production DB changes without approval.

+// Test-only in-memory transport. No client library or environment credentials.
+const calls: { name: string; args: unknown }[] = []
+Object.assign(window, { qaRpcCalls: calls })
+const user = { id: 'qa-user' }
+export const supabase = {
+  auth: {
+    getUser: async () => ({ data: { user }, error: null }),
+    getSession: async () => ({ data: { session: { user } }, error: null }),
+  },
+  from: () => {
+    const query: any = new Proxy({}, { get: (_, key) => key === 'then'
+      ? (resolve: (value: unknown) => void) => Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }).then(resolve)
+      : () => query })
+    return query
+  },
+  rpc: async (name: string, args: unknown) => { calls.push({ name, args }); return { data: [], error: null } },
+}

+import test from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { createPollRequest, pollDisplayResult } from '../src/interactiveRequests.ts'
+
+for (const mode of ['question', 'normal', '', 'QUESTION']) {
+  test(`stale or forged ${mode} mode is rejected before RPC`, () => {
+    assert.throws(() => createPollRequest(mode, 'content', ['A', 'B'], 24, false))
+  })
+}
+for (const count of [2, 3, 4]) {
+  test(`${count} poll choices and privacy mode produce poll-only contract`, () => {
+    const options = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ` ${i} `)
+    const result = createPollRequest('poll', ' content ', options, 24, true)
+    assert.deepEqual(result, { p_content: 'content', p_kind: 'poll', p_options: options.map(s => s.trim()), p_hours: 24, p_is_anonymous: true, p_question_policy: null })
+  })
+}
+for (const [options, hours] of [[['A'], 24], [['A','B','C','D','E'], 24], [['A',' a '], 24], [['','B'], 24], [['x'.repeat(81),'B'], 24], [['A','B'], 0], [['A','B'], NaN]]) {
+  test(`invalid poll parameters ${JSON.stringify([options,hours])} fail closed`, () => {
+    assert.throws(() => createPollRequest('poll', 'content', options, hours, false))
+  })
+}
+test('empty and overlong content fail closed', () => {
+  for (const content of [' ', 'x'.repeat(501)]) assert.throws(() => createPollRequest('poll', content, ['A','B'], 24, false))
+})
+test('anonymous presentation drops identities even in unexpected server payload without mutating it', () => {
+  const payload = { voters: [{ poker_id: 'private', option_index: 0 }], answers: [{ poker_id: 'private' }], total_votes: 1, vote_counts: { 0: 1 } }
+  const result = pollDisplayResult(true, payload)
+  assert.deepEqual(result.voters, [])
+  assert.deepEqual(result.answers, [])
+  assert.equal(result.total_votes, 1)
+  assert.equal(payload.voters.length, 1)
+  assert.equal(pollDisplayResult(false, payload), payload)
+})
+test('both composers use guarded creation; public card cannot mount historical question thread', () => {
+  const timeline = readFileSync(new URL('../src/Timeline.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
+  const card = readFileSync(new URL('../src/TimelineInteractive.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
+  const detail = readFileSync(new URL('../src/PostDetail.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8')
+  assert.match(timeline, /useState<'normal'\|'poll'>/)
+  assert.doesNotMatch(timeline, /questionPolicy|choosePostMode\('question'\)|質問箱/)
+  for (const source of [timeline, card]) {
+    assert.match(source, /createPollRequest\(/)
+    assert.match(source, /rpc\('create_interactive_post_v4', request\)/)
+  }
+  assert.match(card, /if \(item.kind !== 'poll'\) return null/)
+  assert.doesNotMatch(card, /<QuestionThread/)
+  assert.match(card, /export function QuestionThread/)
+  assert.match(timeline, /visibleInteractiveIds.includes\(row.id\)/)
+  assert.match(detail, /interactiveRow\?\.kind === 'question'/)
+  for (const source of [timeline, detail, card]) assert.match(source, /pollDisplayResult\(/)
+})

+-- ISOLATED FIXTURE ONLY. Official Supabase Auth migration, rendered Namespace=auth.
+-- Upstream commit ce9a8eee0cc042be8c7a42981a7ddae631e41d91
+-- Source migrations/20220224000811_update_auth_functions.up.sql
+-- Original Git blob SHA-1 4be423739aa3bf07bc3769aea5cc7751959ad53e
+-- The postgres image initializes pre-2022 Auth helpers; GoTrue normally upgrades
+-- them. Our REST-only fixture applies this exact upstream migration explicitly.
+-- update auth functions
+
+create or replace function auth.uid() 
+returns uuid 
+language sql stable
+as $$
+  select 
+  coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
+    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
+  )::uuid
+$$;
+
+create or replace function auth.role() 
+returns text 
+language sql stable
+as $$
+  select 
+  coalesce(
+    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
+    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
+  )::text
+$$;
+
+create or replace function auth.email() 
+returns text 
+language sql stable
+as $$
+  select

+BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:55431'

+    if result.returncode and not fail_ok: raise AssertionError(result.stderr)

+
+def jwt(user):

+    claims = {'role': 'authenticated' if user else 'anon', 'exp': int(time.time()) + 3600}
+    if user: claims['sub'] = user
+    message = enc({'alg': 'HS256', 'typ': 'JWT'}) + '.' + enc(claims)
+    return message + '.' + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(SECRET, message.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode().rstrip('=')
+
+def api(path, data=None, user=OWNER, method=None, prefer="return=representation"):
+    payload = None if data is None else json.dumps(data).encode()
+    request = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=payload, method=method or ('POST' if payload is not None else 'GET'), headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + jwt(user), 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Prefer': prefer})
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response: status, raw = response.status, response.read()

+    return value
+

prs.body:
## Issue #22：4系列の実コード実装をhost-sessionで起動検証
PR #16を拡張し、共有development lease → 独立pinned worktree → rootの正式collaboration dispatch → immutable acceptance再実行・source/staged hash確認 → controller commitまでを接続しました。A/B/C/Dの実プロジェクト不具合4件でこの流れを実測し、rootが既存の正規GitHub toolsでpush/Draft PRを作成しました。

|系列|実装コミット|Draft PR|CI|
|---|---|---|---|
|A poll不正option数拒否|9bf10fc8de11fd6644876c50439b3e5fc1ffa24d|#27|https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39513425434|
|B 空のoffline問題exportを要確認扱い|a36c7853ca745b40d9607d096b8a2f72c5f5712d|#28|https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39513431818|
|C reach mass overflowの検証エラー化|89fd492422497714d1665a9523e97ad4ba3ebee2|#29|https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39513440363|
|D persona回答数/letter不正の監査FAIL|6e72672fe1b9e51feb6c5b398dd9d757da83e110|#30|https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39513447188|

4suiteとも変更前にFAIL、正式agentsが許可sourceだけを変更し、controllerで5受入caseをPASS確認して4commit作成。同じtaskの再claimは0/4で重複なし。全4Draft PRのpublished-SHA CI成功。証拠はdocs/qa/issue22-workers/のhost-session-results/baseline/publication/no-replay JSON。private prepared token・SQLite本体は公開していません。

### 安全性・能力の境界
- FIFO validationとdevelopment完了を分離。max4task/batch、immutable task/SHA、専用codex branch、期限付きlease・replay拒否、test/path/symlink/no-op/zero-test・source-after-test改変を拒否。完了系列は次のレビュー済taskへ進める。
- 22worker安全性テスト＋15queue回帰PASS。CIのfixtureはreal_AI=falseで、今回の実host証拠と明確に区別します。npm ci/build/lint成功（既存警告あり）。
- Codex CLI adapterは実execを接続済みですが、managed runtimeのEROFS/socket制約でmodel開始前BLOCKED。認証コピー/CODEX_HOME移設/sandbox bypass/API課金はしていません。
- Host receiptはtrusted rootが正式toolsの実dispatch/completionを独立に見て発行。JSONだけがagentIDを暗号学的に証明するわけではありません。
- standalone publisherのAPI認証は未検証。今回はrootの既存正規GitHub toolsで公開し、publisherの成功と偽っていません。
- 既存の有限予約（6h/28回、増設・延長なし）のpromptをhost lifecycleに接続済み。ただし更新後の次回scheduled coldstart→実装完了は未検証、常駐daemonも未稼働。共有state連続性が確認できなければread-only。
- mainmerge・本番DB/SQL・デプロイ・有料サービス追加はなし。

capability契約・起動手順: docs/workers/REAL_CODE_WORKER.md。最新HEADと安全性CIは以下へ追記。

 The coordinator may call record_implementation with an externally witnessed full commit, repository PR URL and CI run URL. This records implemented, never released.  The plan excludes implemented tasks and reveals dependent next tasks only when prerequisites are implemented/succeeded. Missing/cyclic dependencies fail closed. Persisted task specs cannot change under an existing immutable ID.
 The CI state is ephemeral; leases/retry counts are not a deployed cross-run distributed lock. A future code worker needs a durable shared store before unattended writes are enabled. The reservation prompt remains read-only if that prerequisite is absent.
+
+## Issue #22 adapter milestone (2026-10-20)
+A finite real-Codex adapter, separate development leases, exact-path/test/commit guards and optional Draft publisher are now implemented in scripts/code_worker.py. See docs/workers/REAL_CODE_WORKER.md for the capability contract. 22 worker tests (four parallel fixture writers, not real AI) and15 existing queue tests pass. Actual model startup remains BLOCKED by managed-runtime EROFS/socket setup; no auth copy, API billing or sandbox bypass was attempted. Adapter existence and fixture commits are not evidence that four unattended AI developers are running.
+
+An approved host-session lifecycle (prepare → formal collaboration dispatch → finish) is also implemented. It uses the same durable lease/source/test/commit checks and never impersonates a CLI agent. Actual host-session activation evidence is recorded separately from fixture tests and nested-CLI failure; it is not a daemon. See docs/workers/REAL_CODE_WORKER.md.
+
+## Issue #22 actual finite host-session run
+Root prepared four durable development leases and independent pinned worktrees, formally dispatched A/B/C/D collaboration agents, and finalized source/test/hash/commit checks. Four real project defects were fixed and saved as Draft PRs #27/#28/#29/#30. All four acceptance suites first failed; five final acceptance cases pass. Same task reclamation returned0/4, so the completed jobs were not replayed. See docs/workers/REAL_CODE_WORKER.md and public host-session evidence under docs/qa/issue22-workers/.
+This confirms a finite real host-agent implementation cycle, not a permanent daemon. Nested CLI execution remains EROFS-blocked, and future unattended sessions must confirm runtime and durable lease access before claiming work. The standalone publisher adapter remains unverified; the root used its approved GitHub tools to publish controller-created commits.
+
+Root's host output PRs #27–#30 all passed their published-SHA acceptance CI (links in docs/workers/REAL_CODE_WORKER.md). The existing finite six-hour/28-occurrence reservation was updated to use this host lifecycle with retained-state checks; its next cold-start-to-code-completion run remains unverified. Missing shared lease state must fall back to read-only. No scheduler extension, CLI bypass or permanent daemon was introduced.

+# Issue #22 — finite real-code worker adapter
+
+Status: **four real host-session implementations verified; nested CLI remains BLOCKED; no persistent daemon**.
+This is a new implementation on top of PR #16, not a claim that unattended development is running.
+
+## What is implemented
+`scripts/code_worker.py` connects reviewed task descriptors to the installed Codex CLI, not a fixed code-generation template. Its real executor calls `codex exec --ephemeral --sandbox workspace-write` with network disabled for model-generated commands and a restricted shell environment. No model name/provider is silently substituted.
+
+Four lanes can run concurrently, one reviewed task per lane, maximum four tasks/batch. Every task pins a full source commit, dedicated `codex/` branch, exact writable source paths, immutable acceptance-test paths and an allowlisted test profile. The test profile is fixed controller code, not a shell command embedded in queue data. Protected tests must already exist in the pinned source commit; missing tests block execution rather than weakening acceptance.
+
+Shared SQLite WAL state uses `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` to claim development tasks. One running task per lane, random lease tokens, lease expiry becomes BLOCKED, stale/replayed completion is rejected, immutable IDs cannot change task specification, and at most two explicit attempts are possible. Failed worktrees are retained; no automatic reset, overwrite or lease stealing. A shared filesystem setup lock serializes Git worktree preparation.
+
+The model is instructed to edit only reviewed paths. The controller independently rejects no-op output, out-of-scope/ignored-file changes, deleted/symlinked source, changed HEAD and acceptance-test changes. Test-success source hashes must still match after testing, and staged Git blobs must exactly match the tested version. Git hooks/fsmonitor are disabled on controller commands. Commit is created only after tests and these checks pass.
+
+CLI output is bounded to2MiB and task time to180s (lease includes test/commit time). The finite batch uses at most four threads and exits; there is no daemon or self-rescheduling loop. Output text is discarded after collecting event metadata, and exception summaries redact common bearer/token/JWT formats. Those redactors are defense in depth, not permission to put secrets in model output.
+
+Credential separation: API keys, GitHub token and Supabase service-role keys are not passed to the model's shell environment or test process. Codex uses the existing configured subscription authentication; the adapter does not copy auth, change CODEX_HOME, register secrets, select paid APIs or enable services. A separate runtime attestation must confirm existing ChatGPT subscription and no new paid services before opting in. An attestation is a human/coordinator assertion, not proof that authentication/runtime execution works.
+
+## Publication boundary
+Local implementation and publication are separate. Optional `--publish-draft` uses an existing runtime GITHUB_TOKEN in a controller-only API client, checks the exact remote base SHA, refuses any existing remote branch, pushes only a new `codex/` branch using existing Git transport identity, then creates a Draft PR. Tokens are not included in argv, Git config or model/test environments. API failures leave publication BLOCKED. A test-fixture executor is never allowed to publish as real AI output. No merge, deployment, SQL, production DB or billing command exists in this publisher.
+
+`GITHUB_TOKEN` must already be correctly scoped by the runtime. Nothing here provisions or registers a new credential. The managed connector's credentials are not assumed to be available to a child process. A successful push followed by failed PR creation may leave an unmerged branch requiring reconciliation; it is not retried by overwriting the branch.
+
+## Real activation prerequisites
+1. Approved existing-subscription CLI identity, working runtime, and no new chargeable API configuration.
+2. Reviewed immutable tasks with existing protected acceptance tests.
+3. Durable shared SQLite path and work-root accessible by all participating workers; do not use per-run ephemeral CI state as a cross-run lock.
+4. Separate review of untrusted-code sandboxing and runner capability. Post-flight path checks alone are not an external security boundary. Model commands rely on Codex's supported sandbox; never bypass it to make the run work.
+5. For publication, an existing scoped GitHub runtime credential and transport identity, with branch-only write permissions.
+
+The controller can be run manually from an authorized existing runtime:

+`python -B scripts/code_worker.py --manifest /reviewed/tasks.json --repository /clean/repo --work-root /durable/worktrees --state /durable/worker.sqlite --output /durable/run.json --auth-attestation /runtime/subscription-attestation.json --enable-code-writing`

No active manifest is shipped: task instructions and acceptance tests require review before enabling real code writes. The descriptor fields are `id`, `lane`, `base_sha`, `base_branch`, `branch`, `instruction`, `allowed_paths`, `protected_tests`, `test_profile`; repository must be kyoma1015/poker-sns and manifest version1. Test profiles are listed in controller source.

+"""Finite, lease-backed Codex code worker. Real executor is opt-in and fail-closed.
+
+No daemon, model API key, production action, merge or deployment is created here.
+"""
+import argparse
+import concurrent.futures
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import re
+import signal
+import sqlite3
+import subprocess
+import time
+import uuid
+import urllib.request
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import fcntl
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+
+LANES = ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D')
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PROFILES = {
+    'queue': [('python', '-B', 'tests/automation/test_development_queue.py')],
+    'node': [('node', '--test', 'tests/worker-acceptance.test.mjs')],
+    'python': [('python', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests/worker_acceptance', '-v')],
+    'tda': [('node', 'tests/tda-quiz-data.test.mjs')],
+    'diagnosis': [('node', 'tests/player-type.test.mjs')],
+    'worker': [('python', '-B', 'tests/automation/test_code_worker.py')],
+}
+DENIED_PARTS = {'.git', '.github', 'node_modules', 'supabase', 'sql', 'handoff'}
+
+
+def path_ok(value):
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        return False
+    path = PurePosixPath(value)
+    return (value and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
+            and not any(part.lower() in DENIED_PARTS for part in path.parts)
+            and not any(part.startswith('.env') for part in path.parts))
+
+
+def validate_spec(spec):
+    if spec.get('version') != 1 or spec.get('repository') != 'kyoma1015/poker-sns':
+        raise ValueError('unsupported repository/manifest')
+    tasks = spec.get('tasks', [])
+    if not isinstance(tasks, list) or not 1 <= len(tasks) <= 4:
+        raise ValueError('one to four reviewed tasks required')
+    seen = set()
+    for task in tasks:
+        if task.get('lane') not in LANES or task['lane'] in seen:
+            raise ValueError('one task per lane per run')
+        seen.add(task['lane'])
+        if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}', task.get('id', '')):
+            raise ValueError('invalid immutable task ID')
+        if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', task.get('base_sha', '')):
+            raise ValueError('full immutable base SHA required')
+        if not re.fullmatch(r'codex/[a-zA-Z0-9_/-]{1,100}', task.get('branch', '')) or '..' in task['branch']:
+            raise ValueError('dedicated codex branch required')
+        if task.get('test_profile') not in PROFILES:
+            raise ValueError('test profile is not allowlisted')
+        allowed = task.get('allowed_paths', [])
+        protected = task.get('protected_tests', [])
+        if not allowed or not isinstance(allowed, list) or not all(path_ok(x) for x in allowed):
+            raise ValueError('safe exact allowed paths required')
+        if not protected or not all(path_ok(x) for x in protected):
+            raise ValueError('immutable acceptance tests required')
+        if set(allowed) & set(protected):
+            raise ValueError('acceptance tests cannot be edited by worker')
+        if not isinstance(task.get('instruction'), str) or not 1 <= len(task['instruction']) <= 6000:
+            raise ValueError('bounded reviewed instruction required')
+        if 'command' in task or 'shell' in task:
+            raise ValueError('manifest cannot provide executable commands')
+    return spec
+
+
+def scrub(text):
+    text = re.sub(r'(?i)(bearer\s+)[^\s]+', r'\1[REDACTED]', str(text))
+    text = re.sub(r'\b(?:sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\b', '[REDACTED]', text)
+    text = re.sub(r'\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\b', '[REDACTED_JWT]', text)
+    return text[:2000]
+
+
+def child_env(auth=False):
+    # Credentials never enter the model's shell environment or test process.
+    names = ['PATH', 'LANG', 'LC_ALL', 'TMPDIR', 'SYSTEMROOT']
+    if auth:
+        names += ['HOME', 'CODEX_HOME', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'ALL_PROXY', 'NO_PROXY',
+                  'SSL_CERT_FILE', 'SSL_CERT_DIR', 'REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE', 'NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS']
+    result = {key: os.environ[key] for key in names if key in os.environ}
+    result['GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT'] = '0'
+    return result
+
+
+def command(argv, cwd, timeout=60, env=None, include_stderr=False):
+    if argv[0] == 'git':
+        argv = ['git', '-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', '-c', 'core.fsmonitor=false', *argv[1:]]
+    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, timeout=timeout, text=True,
+                            capture_output=True, check=False)
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(scrub(f'{argv[0]} exited {result.returncode}: {result.stderr}'))
+    return (result.stdout + (result.stderr if include_stderr else "")).strip()
+
+
+def acceptance_count(output):
+    counts = re.findall(r'(?:Ran\s+(\d+)\s+tests?|(?:#|ℹ)\s*tests\s+(\d+))', output)
+    return sum(int(left or right) for left, right in counts)
+
+
+class Leases:
+    def __init__(self, path):
+        self.db = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=10, isolation_level=None)
+        self.db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
+        self.db.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=10000')
+        self.db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS development_jobs (
+          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lane TEXT NOT NULL, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+          status TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+          token TEXT, expires REAL, evidence TEXT)''')
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.db.close()
+
+    def claim(self, task, seconds=900, now=None):
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(task, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
+        self.db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        try:
+            self.db.execute("UPDATE development_jobs SET status='blocked', token=NULL, evidence='lease expired; review required' WHERE status='running' AND expires<=?", (now,))
+            old = self.db.execute('SELECT spec_hash,status,attempts FROM development_jobs WHERE id=?', (task['id'],)).fetchone()
+            if old and old[0] != digest:
+                raise ValueError('immutable task ID cannot change specification')
+            active = self.db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM development_jobs WHERE lane=? AND status='running'", (task['lane'],)).fetchone()
+            if active or (old and (old[1] != 'retry_wait' or old[2] >= 2)):
+                self.db.execute('COMMIT')
+                return None
+            token = uuid.uuid4().hex
+            if old:
+                self.db.execute("UPDATE development_jobs SET status='running',attempts=attempts+1,token=?,expires=? WHERE id=?", (token, now + seconds, task['id']))
+            else:
+                self.db.execute("INSERT INTO development_jobs(id,lane,spec_hash,status,attempts,token,expires) VALUES(?,?,?,'running',1,?,?)", (task['id'], task['lane'], digest, token, now + seconds))
+            self.db.execute('COMMIT')
+            return token
+        except BaseException:
+            self.db.execute('ROLLBACK')
+            raise
+
+    def finish(self, task_id, token, status, evidence, now=None):
+        if status not in ('implemented', 'blocked', 'failed', 'retry_wait'):
+            raise ValueError('invalid terminal status')
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        cursor = self.db.execute("UPDATE development_jobs SET status=?,token=NULL,expires=NULL,evidence=? WHERE id=? AND token=? AND status='running' AND expires>?",
+                                 (status, json.dumps(evidence), task_id, token, now))
+        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
+            raise ValueError('invalid/expired lease; cannot publish completion')
+
+    def report(self):
+        rows = self.db.execute('SELECT id,lane,status,attempts,evidence FROM development_jobs ORDER BY rowid').fetchall()
+        return [dict(zip(('id', 'lane', 'status', 'attempts', 'evidence'), row)) for row in rows]
+
+
+def protected_hashes(worktree, paths):
+    result = {}
+    for relative in paths:
+        path = worktree / relative
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise ValueError('immutable acceptance file missing or symlinked: ' + relative)
+        result[relative] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    return result
+
+
+def checked_changes(worktree, allowed):
+    changed = command(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'], worktree).splitlines()
+    untracked = command(['git', 'ls-files', '--others'], worktree).splitlines()
+    staged = command(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], worktree).splitlines()
+    paths = set(changed + untracked + staged)
+    if not paths:
+        raise ValueError('worker did not change source; not implementation')
+    if not paths <= set(allowed):
+        raise ValueError('out-of-scope changes: ' + ','.join(sorted(paths - set(allowed))))
+    for relative in paths:
+        path = worktree / relative
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.exists() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(worktree.resolve()):
+            raise ValueError('symlink/deletion/escape rejected: ' + relative)
+    return sorted(paths)
+
+
+class CodexExecutor:
+    name = 'codex_cli'
+
+    def __init__(self, executable, attestation):
+        self.executable = str(Path(executable).resolve())
+        data = json.loads(Path(attestation).read_text())
+        if data != {'auth_mode': 'existing_chatgpt_subscription', 'owner_confirmed': True,
+                    'new_paid_services': False}:
+            raise ValueError('existing subscription/auth/owner confirmation required; API-key billing unsupported')
+
+    def __call__(self, task, worktree, timeout):
+        prompt = ('Implement exactly the reviewed task below. You may edit only these exact paths: '
+                  + json.dumps(task['allowed_paths']) + '. Do not edit acceptance tests, git metadata, '
+                  'credentials or any other file. Do not commit, push, run network commands, access '
+                  'Supabase/production, change billing, or install services. Keep existing specs. '
+                  'Make a real source fix; the controller runs immutable acceptance tests and commits.\n'
+                  + task['instruction'])
+        argv = [self.executable, 'exec', '--ephemeral', '--sandbox', 'workspace-write',
+                '-c', 'sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=false',
+                '-c', 'shell_environment_policy.inherit="none"',
+                '-c', 'shell_environment_policy.include_only=["PATH","TMPDIR","LANG"]',
+                '--json', '--color', 'never', '-C', str(worktree), '-']
+        # Output is bounded and discarded after extracting non-sensitive event metadata.
+        import tempfile
+        with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as output:
+            process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=worktree, env=child_env(auth=True), stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                       stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
+            try:
+                process.stdin.write(prompt.encode())
+                process.stdin.close()
+                deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+                while process.poll() is None:
+                    if time.monotonic() >= deadline or output.tell() > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
+                        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+                        try:
+                            process.wait(timeout=5)
+                        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                            process.wait()
+                        raise RuntimeError('Codex time/output limit reached')
+                    time.sleep(0.1)
+                output.seek(0)
+                raw = output.read(2 * 1024 * 1024).decode(errors='replace')
+                if process.returncode:
+                    raise RuntimeError('Codex failed: ' + scrub(raw[-1800:]))
+                events = []
+                for line in raw.splitlines():
+                    try:
+                        event = json.loads(line)
+                    except ValueError:
+                        continue
+                    events.append(event.get('type'))
+                return {'executor': self.name, 'exit_code': process.returncode,

+@contextmanager
+def setup_lock(state, seconds=30):
+    """Serialize git worktree preparation across processes sharing durable state."""
+    with open(str(state) + '.setup.lock', 'a') as handle:
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
+        while True:

+                fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+                break
+            except BlockingIOError:
+                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                    raise RuntimeError('git preparation lock timeout')
+                time.sleep(0.05)

+class GitHubPublisher:

+    def __init__(self, token):

+def validate_and_commit(task, worktree, base, before, evidence):
+    if command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], worktree) != base:
+        raise ValueError('executor changed git HEAD; publish forbidden')
+    paths = checked_changes(worktree, task['allowed_paths'])
+    if protected_hashes(worktree, task['protected_tests']) != before:
+        raise ValueError('immutable acceptance tests changed')
+    evidence['changed_paths'] = paths
+    tested_source_hashes = protected_hashes(worktree, paths)
+    tested_git_blobs = {path: command(['git', 'hash-object', '--', path], worktree) for path in paths}
+    evidence['tested_source_sha256'] = tested_source_hashes

+        count = acceptance_count(output)
+        if count < 1:
+            raise ValueError('acceptance command reported no executed tests')
+        evidence['tests'].append({'command': list(argv), 'exit_code': 0,
+                                  'test_count': count, 'output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(output.encode()).hexdigest()})
+    # Recheck after tests; a test fixture cannot leave unreviewed changes.
+    checked_changes(worktree, task['allowed_paths'])
+    if protected_hashes(worktree, task['protected_tests']) != before:
+        raise ValueError('acceptance test tampering detected after test run')
+    if protected_hashes(worktree, paths) != tested_source_hashes:

+def run_task(repository, work_root, state, task, executor, timeout=180):
+    leases = Leases(state)
+    token = leases.claim(task, seconds=min(1800, timeout + 180))
+    if token is None:
+        leases.close()
+        return {'id': task['id'], 'status': 'skipped_existing_lease_or_result'}
+    evidence = {'id': task['id'], 'lane': task['lane'], 'base_sha': task['base_sha'],

+                'real_ai_implementation': False}

+            raise ValueError('worktree path already exists; preserve and review before retry')

+    except Exception as error:

+        try:
+            leases.finish(task['id'], token, 'blocked', evidence)

+def prepare_host_session(repository, work_root, state, task, now=None):
+    """Trusted host coordinator only: acquire lease before collaboration dispatch."""
+    validate_spec({'version': 1, 'repository': 'kyoma1015/poker-sns', 'tasks': [task]})

+    token = leases.claim(task, seconds=1500, now=now)

+            command(['git', 'worktree', 'add', '-b', task['branch'], str(worktree), base], repository)

+        leases.db.execute('UPDATE development_jobs SET evidence=? WHERE id=? AND token=?',
+                          (json.dumps(context), task['id'], token))

+                'lease_token': token, 'executor': 'host_session', 'real_ai_implementation': False,
+                'next': 'Trusted coordinator dispatches a formal collaboration agent; never treat preparation as execution.'}

+def finish_host_session(state, task_id, token, receipt, now=None):
+    """Verify host-agent changes and commit. Receipt must come from trusted coordinator.

+    This is not an API that cryptographically verifies a collaboration identity.
+    Agent output alone is untrusted; the host coordinator owns this invocation.

+    if (receipt.get('task_id') != task_id or receipt.get('dispatch_source') != 'collaboration'
+            or receipt.get('completed') is not True
+            or not re.fullmatch(r'/root/[a-z0-9_/]+', receipt.get('agent_id', ''))):
+        raise ValueError('trusted coordinator collaboration receipt required')
+    leases = Leases(state)
+    current = time.time() if now is None else now
+    row = leases.db.execute("SELECT evidence FROM development_jobs WHERE id=? AND token=? AND status='running' AND expires>?", (task_id, token, current)).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        leases.close()

+    if context.get('prepared_for') != 'host_session':
+        leases.close()
+        raise ValueError('task was not prepared for host collaboration')
+    task = context['task']
+    evidence = {'id': task_id, 'lane': task['lane'], 'base_sha': task['base_sha'],
+                'executor': 'host_session', 'host_agent_id': receipt['agent_id'],
+                'real_ai_implementation': False, 'production': False,
+                'receipt_source': 'trusted_host_coordinator', 'daemon_running': False}

+        validate_and_commit(task, Path(context['worktree']), context['base_sha'], context['before'], evidence)
+        evidence['status'] = 'implemented_local'
+        evidence['real_ai_implementation'] = receipt.get('test_fixture') is not True
+        evidence['publication'] = 'not_attempted'
+        leases.finish(task_id, token, 'implemented', evidence, now=now)
+    except Exception as error:
+        evidence.update(status='blocked', error=scrub(error))
+        try:
+            leases.finish(task_id, token, 'blocked', evidence, now=now)
+        except ValueError:
+            evidence['lease_status'] = 'expired; cannot finalize'
+    finally:
+        leases.close()
+    return evidence

+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

+    parser.add_argument('--work-root', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--state', type=Path, required=True)

+    parser.add_argument('--enable-code-writing', action='store_true')
+    parser.add_argument('--publish-draft', action='store_true')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    spec = validate_spec(json.loads(args.manifest.read_text()))
+    if not args.enable_code_writing or args.auth_attestation is None:
+        parser.error('real code writing is opt-in and requires verified existing-subscription attestation')
+    executor = CodexExecutor(args.codex, args.auth_attestation)

+                except Exception as error:
+                    result['publication'] = {'status': 'blocked', 'error': scrub(error)}
+    report = {'finite_batch': True, 'new_paid_services': False, 'daemon_running': False,
+              'real_ai_implementations': sum(result.get('real_ai_implementation', False) for result in results),
+              'tasks': results}
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
+    return 0 if all(result.get('status') == 'implemented_local' for result in results) else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Host coordinator bridge. Does not impersonate or spawn a collaboration agent.
+
+Prepare -> formal host collaboration dispatch -> finish with coordinator receipt.
+The host's tools/permissions remain the authority; this command adds no capability.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from code_worker import prepare_host_session, finish_host_session, validate_spec
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('phase', choices=('prepare', 'finish'))
+    parser.add_argument('--manifest', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('--task-id', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--repository', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('--work-root', type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument('--state', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--prepared', type=Path, required=True, help='coordinator-owned lease receipt, outside agent worktree')
+    parser.add_argument('--receipt', type=Path, help='trusted coordinator records the actual formal collaboration agent')
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.phase == 'prepare':
+        if not args.manifest or not args.repository or not args.work_root:
+            parser.error('prepare requires manifest, repository and work-root')
+        spec = validate_spec(json.loads(args.manifest.read_text()))
+        tasks = [task for task in spec['tasks'] if task['id'] == args.task_id]
+        if len(tasks) != 1:
+            parser.error('reviewed task ID missing')
+        args.work_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        result = prepare_host_session(args.repository.resolve(), args.work_root.resolve(), args.state.resolve(), tasks[0])
+        if result['status'] == 'prepared':
+            # Never commit or give this coordinator-only lease token to the model.
+            args.prepared.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+            args.prepared.chmod(0o600)
+        public = {key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != 'lease_token'}
+    else:
+        if args.receipt is None:
+            parser.error('finish requires coordinator receipt')
+        prepared = json.loads(args.prepared.read_text())
+        if prepared['id'] != args.task_id:
+            parser.error('prepared task mismatch')
+        public = finish_host_session(args.state.resolve(), args.task_id, prepared['lease_token'], json.loads(args.receipt.read_text()))
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(public, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(public, indent=2))
+    return 0 if public['status'] in ('prepared', 'implemented_local') else 2
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+        task = self.task(); task['shell'] = 'ignored but rejected'
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

+        git(self.repo, 'add', '.')
+        git(self.repo, 'commit', '-m', 'mutating acceptance fixture')
+        self.sha = git(self.repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
+        result = worker.run_task(self.repo, self.work, self.state, self.task(), FixtureExecutor())
+        self.assertEqual(result['status'], 'blocked')
+        self.assertIn('source changed during tests', result['error'])
+        self.assertNotIn('commit', result)
+
+    def test_wrong_or_replayed_lease_cannot_finish(self):
+        leases = worker.Leases(self.state)

+                leases.finish(self.task()['id'], 'wrong', 'implemented', {}, now=101)

prs.title: [C/Issue22] Verify hand-derived ante, rake and side-pot settlements
prs.head: codex/c-issue22-settlement-20261020
prs.body:
## Concrete continuation of PR #20
Adds 17 hand-derived **synthetic** settlement expectations, a reusable replay runner, and a test-only C++ bridge exposing the unchanged embedded Ledger actually used by the G12 variants. Both kernels must match explicit expected chip results, not just each other; legal actions/state are compared after each step, then full settlement and chip conservation.

Coverage: ante/blind priority, short BB, after-ante stacks, no-flop-no-drop, uncalled refunds, multiple side pots, folded-seat ineligibility, odd chips, rake-ante inclusion/exclusion, whole-hand/per-pot caps, and floor/nearest/ceil rounding.

## Verification
Local: 38 Python tests PASS (20 added, prior18 retained); 17 native/reference expected-value fixture comparisons PASS; npm ci/build/lint and application89 tests PASS with existing warnings. Reused the reconstructed/pinned PR20 dependency environment for local native bridge; CI rebuilds the environment afresh. Header and Rules.py hashes are verified before use; original sources remain unchanged.
Commit: 6b9bf03f63f1c5f23dc4271ad8714f5f8bbea04e.
Evidence: docs/qa/gto-settlement-20261020/; reproducible commands gto/README.md. Native/app CI now also target the PR20 branch.

## Unresolved policy edge (no speculative fix)
Both original kernels reject positive_live dead-ante eligibility when a short BB's entire stack pays dead ante and the unmatched blind is refunded, leaving no live eligible seat. Recorded as BLOCKED_RULE_POLICY; the all_live example is independently tested. House rules were not changed.

These are hand-derived candidate-rule fixtures, **not recovered G11 baseline or approved production profiles**. Original vendor, baseline settings, target20 stack/bet fixtures and historical checkpoint are still unavailable. No main merge, deploy, DB, checkpoint writes, source replacement or paid services.

Next independent worker descriptor: gto/tasks/rank7-next.json (allowed paths, commands, acceptance criteria, known issues, prohibited actions). This PR does not start a persistent developer.

## Confirmed CI — 6b9bf03f63f1c5f23dc4271ad8714f5f8bbea04e
- Native/GTO CI **SUCCESS**: 38 Python unit tests, original transferred-source/backend checks, 3 native reconstruction/smoke variants and new 17 hand-derived Python/native settlement cases. https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39512678577
- Application CI **SUCCESS**: locked install, application89 unit tests, build, lint, mock browser5. https://github.com/kyoma1015/poker-sns/actions/runs/39512678542
Native job logs confirm case_count=17 for the expected-value settlement bridge. All baseline/provenance limitations above remain; CI does not approve a production house rule or reconstruct a historical checkpoint.
